```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  kani-verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install Kani
        run: cargo install kani-verify

      - name: Run Kani verification on storage crate
        run: cargo kani --features kani -p storage
```
